full_judgment: 8. It may be stated that originally the suit was filed by Rustam Ali and his deceased wife Jobeda Khatun, the predecessor-in-interest of the plaintiffs with the prayer for declaration of title in the suit schedules Ka, Ga and Gha properties and for permanent injunction with a prayer for recovery of Khas possession of Gha schedule property which was dismissed on contest in trial. On the appeal preferred by them the earlier judgment and decree of the trial Court was set aside and the case was sent back on remand to the trial Court for retrial with some directions. During retrial the plaintiffs amended their plaint by inserting the present prayer on amending some earlier statements.
